opportunities.name: Supplier quote comparison (currency conversion + supplier local time) emailed to procurement
opportunities.description: For a given item, convert two supplier quotes (amount and currency) to USD on xe.com, look up the cheaper supplier's local time on timeanddate.com, then draft an email to procurement@example.com with the USD comparison, the cheaper currency and the supplier's local time.
steps: Open xe.com currency converter (Convert tab)
Set the From currency to quote 1's currency and the To currency to USD
Enter quote 1's amount and note the USD value
Change the From currency to quote 2's currency, enter quote 2's amount and note the USD value
Work out which quote is cheaper in USD
On timeanddate.com World Clock, search the supplier city and note the current local time and time zone
Open New message and set To: procurement@example.com
Set Subject: 'Quotes: <item>'
Body: '<amt1> <cur1> = <usd1> USD, <amt2> <cur2> = <usd2> USD, cheaper: <cur>. Supplier time in <city>: <time> <tz>'
Send or discard the draft

instances.values: CNC enclosures: 12,500 EUR vs 1,950,000 JPY; supplier city Osaka
Shipping boxes: 8,200 GBP vs 780,000 INR; supplier city Pune
Partial, no email seen: 64,000 INR vs 14,500 CNY (interrupted by other tasks)

opportunities.name: Account brief from SEC EDGAR + Wikipedia
opportunities.description: For a public company ticker, find its latest 10-K filing date on SEC EDGAR full-text search, get HQ, employee count and CEO from Wikipedia, then email the brief to dana@example.com.
opportunities.site: efts.sec.gov EDGAR full-text search, en.wikipedia.org, internal webmail compose
steps: Open EDGAR full-text search and enter the ticker in the company field
Select the matching company from the autocomplete list
Filter results by Form = 10-K and note the most recent filing date
Search Wikipedia for the company and open its article
Note HQ, number of employees and CEO from the infobox
Open New message and set To: dana@example.com
Set Subject: 'Account brief: <Company> (<TICKER>)'
Body: '<Company>: HQ <city>, <N> employees, CEO <name>. Latest 10-K filed <date>.'
Send or discard the draft

instances.values: Snowflake (SNOW): HQ Menlo Park, 9,060 employees, CEO Sridhar Ramaswamy, 10-K 2026-03-20
Datadog (DDOG): HQ New York City, 8,100 employees, CEO Olivier Pomel, 10-K 2026-02-18
Partial: HubSpot (HUBS), EDGAR search and Form filter only, no email seen

opportunities.name: Cross-office sync planning (time difference + holidays) emailed to ops
opportunities.description: For two office cities and a target month, get their time difference on the timeanddate.com Time Zone Converter, look up public holidays in the relevant country for that month, then email ops@example.com with the offset and the dates to avoid.
steps: Open timeanddate.com, then Time Zones > Time Zone Converter
Add city A and pick it from the dropdown
Add city B and pick it from the dropdown, then note the hours ahead
Go to Calendar > Holidays, choose the relevant country and note the holidays in the target month
Open New message and set To: ops@example.com
Set Subject: 'Sync: <City A> / <City B>, <Month>'
Body: '<City B> is <offset> ahead from <City A>. Avoid: <date1> and <date2>.'
Send or discard the draft

instances.values: San Francisco / Bangalore, October: 12h30 ahead; avoid Oct 2 and Oct 20 (India)
New York / Berlin, December: 6h ahead; avoid Dec 25 and Dec 26 (Germany)
